race.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
race.verdict: ONE FOR HARVEY is drawn widest but arrives in good form and can resume winning ways with her latest Southwell third looking strong form. Davorge Nation made a positive start for the Tony Carroll yard last time and is also shortlisted, whilst the balance of Little Jaybee 's recent form suggests she can be competitive if over whatever seemed to ail her last time. ONE FOR HARVEY DAVORGE NATION (IRE) LITTLE JAYBEE
